basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) has announced 6 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post on a contract basis for 36 Months or termination of the project, whichever is earlier. Eligible applicants holding a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or equivalent national level examinations by Central Government Departments/Agencies can apply online. qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b) The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc.

how_to_apply: Deposit the application fee through RTGS, NEFT, or Net Banking into the designated bank account: STATE BANK OF INDIA (00202), Branch Address: P.O: KHARAGPUR TECHNOLOGY, DIST: MIDNAPORE, WEST BENGAL-721302, Account Name: IIT SRIC-OM Account, Account No: 39502115210, IFSC Code: SBIN0000202, SWIFT Code: SBININBB339.
Note down the transaction details such as UTR No. or Transaction ID.

Submit your application online through the official portal on or before 3 November 2026, ensuring that all relevant areas of expertise and specific evidence of hands-on experience are clearly provided.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 6 temporary Junior Research Fellow positions available under the Aerospace Engineering department.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification criteria and possess demonstrable, hands-on experience in at least one of the seven specified technical areas (Computational Fluid Dynamics, Experimental Research and Propulsion Testing, Instrumentation and Data Acquisition, Control Systems and System Identification, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Signal Processing and Data Analysis, or Applied Physics, Plasma, and Advanced Diagnostics). Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b) The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Age limit is relaxable up to 5 years in the case of SC/ST/OBC/Physically Handicapped / Visually Handicapped and female applicants.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation per month is up to Rs. 37,000, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure of the appointment is 36 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Deposit the application fee through RTGS, NEFT, or Net Banking into the designated bank account: STATE BANK OF INDIA (00202), Branch Address: P.O: KHARAGPUR TECHNOLOGY, DIST: MIDNAPORE, WEST BENGAL-721302, Account Name: IIT SRIC-OM Account, Account No: 39502115210, IFSC Code: SBIN0000202, SWIFT Code: SBININBB339. Note down the transaction details such as UTR No. or Transaction ID. Submit your application online through the official portal on or before 3 November 2026, ensuring that all relevant areas of expertise and specific evidence of hands-on experience are clearly provided.

faq.question: Q1. Is there any application fee for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: No, the application fee is Rs. 0 for all categories including General, OBC, Female, and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of the advertisement, with relaxation up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Handicapped/Visually Handicapped and female applicants.

faq.question: Q3. What is the duration of the JRF assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 36 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier, on a purely time-bound research project basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications online is November 03, 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly compensation offered for this role?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on the candidate's qualification and experience.
